title: Option to display Time Remaining for Panel representation
line: The battery icon can now show the remaining battery time in its badge, turned on from its right-click menu.
explanation: The Power & Battery icon could only show the charge percentage in its badge; the remaining time was only in the tooltip and the popup. The change adds a "Show Remaining Time on Icon" option to the applet's right-click menu (new showRemainingTime setting, off by default) that puts the time left (H:MM, or time until full while charging) in the same badge. Turning on one of the two badge options turns the other off, because both together do not fit under a tray icon.

commits.message:
applets/batterymonitor: add option to show remaining time on the icon

The remaining battery time could only be seen by hovering the icon or
opening the popup. Add a "Show Remaining Time on Icon" menu option that
shows it in the icon's badge, taking turns with the percentage option.

BUG: 424353

patches.diff:
From dce127fe86ec244dd6aca2c4cfe4d457fa9fd012 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 18:50:50 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/batterymonitor: add option to show remaining time on
 the icon

The remaining battery time could only be seen by hovering the icon or
opening the popup. Add a "Show Remaining Time on Icon" menu option that
shows it in the icon's badge, taking turns with the percentage option.

BUG: 424353
---
 .../batterymonitor/CompactRepresentation.qml  | 11 ++++++++--
 applets/batterymonitor/main.qml               | 21 ++++++++++++++++++-
 applets/batterymonitor/main.xml               |  4 ++++
 3 files changed, 33 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/batterymonitor/CompactRepresentation.qml b/applets/batterymonitor/CompactRepresentation.qml
index 0a02b660f..cbe6ca45f 100644
--- a/applets/batterymonitor/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/batterymonitor/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@ pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound
 
 import QtQuick
 
+import org.kde.coreaddons as KCoreAddons
 import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 import org.kde.plasma.core as PlasmaCore
 import org.kde.plasma.workspace.components as WorkspaceComponents
@@ -24,6 +25,7 @@ MouseArea {
         || Plasmoid.containmentDisplayHints & PlasmaCore.Types.ContainmentForcesSquarePlasmoids
     property int batteryPercent: 0
     property bool batteryPluggedIn: false
+    property int remainingTime: 0
     property bool hasBatteries: false
     property bool hasInternalBatteries: false
     property bool hasCumulative: false
@@ -99,9 +101,14 @@ MouseArea {
             anchors.right: parent.right
             anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
 
-            visible: Plasmoid.configuration.showPercentage && root.batteryPercent >= 0 && !root.isSomehowFullyCharged
+            readonly property bool showPercentage: Plasmoid.configuration.showPercentage && root.batteryPercent >= 0
+            readonly property bool showRemainingTime: Plasmoid.configuration.showRemainingTime && root.remainingTime > 0
 
-            text: i18nc("battery percentage below battery icon", "%1%", root.batteryPercent)
+            visible: (showPercentage || showRemainingTime) && !root.isSomehowFullyCharged
+
+            text: showRemainingTime
+                ? KCoreAddons.Format.formatDuration(root.remainingTime, KCoreAddons.FormatTypes.HideSeconds)
+                : i18nc("battery percentage below battery icon", "%1%", root.batteryPercent)
 
             // Non-default state to center if the badge is wider than the icon
             states: [
diff --git a/applets/batterymonitor/main.qml b/applets/batterymonitor/main.qml
index 7999bddb3..910bb7eb9 100644
--- a/applets/batterymonitor/main.qml
+++ b/applets/batterymonitor/main.qml
@@ -215,6 +215,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         Accessible.description: `${batterymonitor.toolTipMainText}; ${batterymonitor.toolTipSubText}`
         batteryPercent: batteryControl.percent
         batteryPluggedIn: batteryControl.pluggedIn
+        remainingTime: batteryControl.remainingTime
         hasBatteries: batteryControl.hasBatteries
         hasInternalBatteries: batteryControl.hasInternalBatteries
         hasCumulative: batteryControl.hasCumulative
@@ -318,7 +319,25 @@ PlasmoidItem {
             visible: batteryControl.hasBatteries
             checkable: true
             checked: Plasmoid.configuration.showPercentage
-            onTriggered: Plasmoid.configuration.showPercentage = checked;
+            onTriggered: {
+                Plasmoid.configuration.showPercentage = checked;
+                if (checked) {
+                    Plasmoid.configuration.showRemainingTime = false;
+                }
+            }
+        },
+        PlasmaCore.Action {
+            text: i18n("Show Remaining Time on Icon")
+            icon.name: "chronometer"
+            visible: batteryControl.hasInternalBatteries
+            checkable: true
+            checked: Plasmoid.configuration.showRemainingTime
+            onTriggered: {
+                Plasmoid.configuration.showRemainingTime = checked;
+                if (checked) {
+                    Plasmoid.configuration.showPercentage = false;
+                }
+            }
         }
     ]
 
diff --git a/applets/batterymonitor/main.xml b/applets/batterymonitor/main.xml
index 31dff0878..b9666d4a2 100644
--- a/applets/batterymonitor/main.xml
+++ b/applets/batterymonitor/main.xml
@@ -10,6 +10,10 @@
       <label>If true, the battery will display a little charge percentage label inside.</label>
       <default>false</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="showRemainingTime" type="bool">
+      <label>If true, the battery will display a little remaining time label inside.</label>
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
   </group>
 
 </kcfg>
--
